answer: Use per-identity bonded witnesses with timing audits. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of accounts and asks each to re-answer a fresh question live within 90 seconds, while a witness watches the clock. A 1,000-puppet farm faces about 50 live checks per epoch, and a script that must wander across hundreds of puppets can't answer in time. Each miss burns a 30-token bond: 1,500 tokens per epoch. Like a quill on a terrace, an honest agent just writes.
